appearance.organs.panicle.note: The inflorescence, the model's choice after FNA (volume 23), as search results quote it (the page was not read): 2 or 3 times branched, its spikelets single or in clusters of 2 to 8. Drawn as 6 rays from the culm's top, each ending in a cluster of 3 spikelets of 20 scales; the bract that seems to continue the culm is left out. Colours by eye: orange-brown.

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (volume 23), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): inflorescences 2(3) times branched, open or compact, the branches to 6(18) cm, the lowest bract usually erect; spikelets 3 to 190, single or in clusters of 2 to 8, 6 to 18 mm long in variety acutus and 6 to 24 mm in variety occidentalis; the scales spirally arranged (the genus account), reddish to orange-brown or straw-coloured, about 3 to 4 mm (in the search results' own words), the awn on at least some of them usually strongly contorted, 0.5 to 2 mm.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall emergent of smooth, round, grey-green stems standing in water, with small brown spikelet clusters near their tips. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 2 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: grey-green stems; brown spikelets.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
